entries.finding: No green remote quality/security/candidate runs on the candidate SHA; same-SHA unproven.
entries.impact: Promotion blocked; remote assurance missing for the exact tree.
entries.mitigation: Push + tag/dispatch with token; candidate pipeline runs all gates remotely.

entries.finding: Remote quality E2E step fails in CI without accessible logs; local reproductions (Node 22/24, CI mode) pass 45/45.
entries.impact: Quality workflow red; root cause undiagnosed (environmental suspected).
entries.mitigation: E2E diagnostics hardened (§13); rerun on next push; escalate with CI log access.

entries.finding: Mutation assurance covers 5 critical files; worker/outbox, diagnostic machine and remaining use-cases unmutated.
entries.impact: Undetected logic gaps possible outside the measured scope.
entries.mitigation: Adjusted 97.82% on covered scope; expand by criticality next.

entries.finding: Files over 1000 lines remain (registries, repositories, web pages).
entries.impact: Larger blast radius on change; mitigated by budgets and ratchets.
entries.mitigation: Complexity budgets enforced; split only with proven gain.

entries.finding: Branch coverage margin thin above the 86% hardening target.
entries.impact: Future test changes could dip below target before the floor.
entries.mitigation: Floor gate at 85% plus hardening tests; monitor per run.
Axe clean; AT audit when users onboard.
